description:
On 2026-10-22, updating item context with a progress note (update_item with context) replaced the field and removed the COMMON GUARDRAILS C1-C10 block from 15 batch items; they were restored by hand from the original specs. There is no append mode, and nothing warns that a large field is being replaced by a much shorter one. Related friction in the same session: defer is refused on a done item, so the order finish-then-defer silently loses the deferral; the deferral summary has an undocumented 200-character limit (not in the tool schema).

CHANGE: add an append/prepend option for text fields (or a separate note operation), and document field limits and lifecycle restrictions in the tool schemas.
